author: fullmeo

test_results.reason: Code cannot compile due to import errors - imports reference non-existent paths and types

lessons: Integration smoke test: Check import paths and directory structure exist before deep review (saved 90% review time)
Buzzword detection: 'Consciousness-driven' and 'therapeutic insights' were red flags for over-engineering
Cost claims need data: '30-50% cost reduction' was backwards - actually doubles API calls
Test coverage ≠ integration: 95% coverage of isolated code but 0% integration with Kilo
INTEGRATION.md smoking gun: 'Copy files from another repo' revealed this wasn't built for Kilo
Unsolicited 4k-line features need prior discussion: No issue, no alignment, no incremental approach
Architecture mismatch is fundamental: VS Code extension vs gateway service - can't be reconciled with edits
When to close: No integration + wrong architecture + no discussion = recommend closing, not iterating
review_notes: This is code from a different project (Magnus 14/15 framework) submitted to Kilo without integration. Creates /src/gateway/ directory that doesn't exist, imports types that don't exist, assumes architecture that doesn't exist. Claims to reduce API costs 30-50% but actually adds API calls to Claude for 'code quality scoring'. References 'consciousness-driven framework' and 'therapeutic insights' which are standard linting checks rebranded with buzzwords. Well-written code in isolation, but completely incompatible with Kilo's VS Code extension architecture. Recommendation: Close with suggestion to open issue first if feature is desired.
